content_of_post_to_answer: Are you afraid of making mistakes?
answer: Fear of mistakes is often less about the mistake itself and more about what we believe it says about us. A wrong choice can feel like evidence that we are incapable, when it is actually information about our approach. I’ve written more about this pattern of turning errors into learning on my profile, if you want to explore the idea further. The people who grow fastest are not those who avoid mistakes, but those who stop treating mistakes as verdicts.
